rows.corpus_definition: A very steep rock face, usually by the water.
rows.example_en: Be careful near the edge of the cliff.

rows.corpus_definition: A high, steep rock face by the sea or mountains.
rows.example_en: The birds nested high on the rocky cliff.

rows.corpus_definition: The land next to the large salt water areas.
rows.example_en: They live on the west coast.

rows.corpus_definition: a long box in which a dead person is buried
rows.example_en: They carried the coffin slowly into the church.

rows.corpus_definition: to suddenly fall down or fail completely
rows.example_en: The old bridge collapsed under the weight of the truck.

rows.corpus_definition: someone that you work with at the same place
rows.example_en: My colleague is helping me with this project.

rows.corpus_definition: A group of things that you have gathered.
rows.example_en: He has a large stamp collection.

rows.corpus_definition: a person who tells jokes to make people laugh
rows.example_en: The famous comedian made the audience laugh.

rows.corpus_definition: a group given authority to do a task, or a fee paid for work
rows.example_en: The agent earned a commission on every house sold.

rows.corpus_definition: the group of people who live in the same area.
rows.example_en: Everyone in the community helped clean the park.

rows.corpus_definition: All the people living in one specific area.

rows.corpus_definition: small and neatly arranged to save space
rows.example_en: She bought a compact camera for the trip.
